description: React component implementing a Tic Tac Toe game UI, including game logic, rendering, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner in the current game state, returning the winner symbol and winning line indices.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if the game board is full, indicating a draw if no winner.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component for the Tic Tac Toe game UI, managing game state and rendering the game interface.

methods.name: handleSquareClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on game board cells, updating game state accordingly.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state, clearing the board and setting the first turn to 'X'.
